updates.title: He decidido seguir a Cristo / I Have Decided to Follow Jesus

sections.label: Verse 1
linesEn: I have decided to follow Jesus;
I have decided to follow Jesus;
I have decided to follow Jesus;
No turning back, no turning back.
linesEs: No vuelvo atrás, no vuelvo atrás.

sections.label: Verse 2
linesEn: If no one joins me, still I will follow;
If no one joins me, still I will follow;
If no one joins me, still I will follow;
No turning back, no turning back.
linesEs: Si otros vuelven, yo sigo a Cristo,
si otros vuelven, yo sigo a Cristo,
si otros vuelven, yo sigo a Cristo.
No vuelvo atrás, no vuelvo atrás.

sections.label: Verse 3
linesEn: The cross before me, the world behind me;
The cross before me, the world behind me;
The cross before me, the world behind me;
No turning back, no turning back.
linesEs: La cruz delante y el mundo atrás,
la cruz delante y el mundo atrás,
la cruz delante y el mundo atrás.
No vuelvo atrás, no vuelvo atrás.

updates.notes: Hymnary notes “Though none go with me” is a traditional variant of stanza 2. Spanish from Himnario Adventista 2010 #281.

updates.title: When the Roll Is Called Up Yonder / Cuando allá se pase lista

sections.label: Verse 1
linesEn: When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound, and time shall be no more,
And the morning breaks, eternal, bright, and fair;
When the saved of earth shall gather over on the other shore,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.
linesEs: Y que el alba eterna rompa en claridad;
Y que sea pasada lista, allí he de estar.

sections.label: Chorus
linesEn: When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.
linesEs: A mi nombre yo feliz responderé.

sections.label: Verse 2
linesEn: On that bright and cloudless morning when the dead in Christ shall rise,
And the glory of His resurrection share;
When His chosen ones shall gather to their home beyond the skies,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.
linesEs: En que muerte ya no habrá,
Y su gloria el Salvador impartirá;
Y que sea pasada lista, allí he de estar.

sections.label: Chorus
linesEn: When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.
linesEs: A mi nombre yo feliz responderé.

sections.label: Verse 3
linesEn: Let us labor for the Master from the dawn till setting sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and care;
Then when all of life is over, and our work on earth is done,
And the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.
linesEs: Siempre hablemos de su amor y fiel bondad;
Y que sea pasada lista, allí he de estar.

sections.label: Chorus
linesEn: When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder,
When the roll is called up yonder, I'll be there.
linesEs: A mi nombre yo feliz responderé.

updates.filled: Removed appended “I want to be a worker”; replaced typo “saved diverse” with official hymnal English; added published Spanish
updates.notes: Spanish from the church’s existing published text in the sister record and https://celeste-iglesiadecristo.com/himnos/cuando-alla-se-pase-lista. Typo “En qué muerte” corrected to “En que muerte”.

splits.removed: I will work, I will pray / I want to be a worker for the Lord
